none: PAS NLM-019052: Finger Ring from Stokeham
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of Roman silver finger-ring. Originally with a broad hoop elliptical in cross-section, the surviving fragment is of one expanding shoulder with lipped edges and a rounded and raised central moulding.
